_comment: Full-body muscle catalog. Data-driven: adding/editing a muscle here is all that's needed to make it selectable — no pipeline code changes. anchor_landmarks reference MediaPipe Pose's 33 landmark names (pose/types.py). cutout_asset files are NOT yet populated (see assets/anatomy/README.md) — compositing/assets.py renders a clearly labeled placeholder until curated cutouts exist. Hebrew terminology and exact anatomical placement need professional sign-off before clinical/production use (see README validation checklist).
